emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics could seize leadership if its momentum score exceeds Industrial Metals by more than 0.05 and its breadth (currently 0.06) rises above 0.2. Unless both conditions emerge, no confirmed handoff is observed.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is the highest-ranked eligible theme by momentum score, but its low breadth (0.06) and mixed Hurst exponent signal fragile trend.
